data.name: Mo Wu Tian Gong
data.detailed_description:
Game Name: Mo Wu Tian Gong

Step into the vast, ancient Eastern world of *Mo Wu Tian Gong*, an open-world action-survival game. Experience a unique adventure that blends hardcore combat, deep crafting, and mystical Taoist cultivation.

**Core Gameplay:**

* **Open World Exploration:** Freely explore a majestic, painterly landscape of misty mountains, bamboo forests, and crumbling ruins, each filled with secrets, resources, and danger.

* **Survival & Building:** Gather resources, hunt, and endure the elements. Establish your sanctuary, evolving it from a simple shelter into a fortified estate with workshops and alchemy labs.

* **Souls-like Combat:** Master a precise, skill-based combat system. Wield traditional weapons and execute fluid martial arts techniques to overcome challenging enemies and epic bosses.

* **Taoist Spell Crafting:** Unlock the secrets of the Five Elements. Harness elemental magic to unleash devastating spells in combat or to enchant your weapons and fortify your constructions.

**Key Features:**

* **Unique "Ink & Ascent" Aesthetic:** Immerse yourself in a world inspired by ink-wash painting and Taoist philosophy.

* **Solo & Multiplayer:** Journey alone as a solitary warrior or unite with friends to build settlements and conquer challenges together in online co-op.

* **Deep Systems Synergy:** Seamlessly blend survival, building, combat, and magic. Create enchanted gear and empower your base through alchemy and elemental fusion.

Forge your own path in *Mo Wu Tian Gong*—will you be a master survivor, an unparalleled martial artist, or an enlightened mystic? The choice is yours.

data.short_description: Mo Wu Tian Gong is an open-world survival-action game set in mythic ancient China. As both builder and warrior, you will "plan with ink, fight with steel" in a fractured yet beautiful world. Survive by gathering resources, constructing shelters, and farming.
